author: Yffe
content: The honest-status discipline (the af340c64 REQ-10 precedent): a ## REQ status row must be true at its own SHA. .design/verified/proof-backends.md line ~2386 says 'NOTHING of §4.2 is built — the gap is pure ABSENCE' and 'lean/Thermite/ has NO whileBodyDenote/whileBodyConverges/loopDenote_fuel_mono/whileBodyConverges_unique/while_compose/loopDenote_exits_of_dec and NO PinWhileVacuity.lean/PinWhileComposition.lean', with SUB-ROWS (all NOT-STARTED) — yet commit 99c7f304 itself adds all six pieces (lean/Thermite/Exec/WhileBody.lean) and both pins, and the same commit's Requirements-section REQ-11 entry says 'SPINE PREREQUISITE — SHIPPED (#264 part v-a)' for REQ-11.1/.2/.3/.6. Mechanical refutation: lean/Thermite/PinWhileDecShape.lean (committed with this audit) imports Thermite.Exec.WhileBody and applies loopDenote_exits_of_dec — kernel-checked existence of the artifacts the row denies. Generator must move the REQ-11 table row to the SHIPPED-sub-rows form (mirroring the REQ-10 row) or split the v-a status honestly.
